transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you in today?

I came in because... well, for a long time now I've just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling. It's like, even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me, I still feel down. I just feel kind of empty most days, honestly.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or that you don’t take pleasure in them the way you used to?

No, not really. I mean, I still do the things I usually enjoy, and I still want to do them. Like my hobbies and stuff... I haven't really lost interest. I just still have that flat feeling in the background while I'm doing them. But yeah, the interest is still there, I haven't noticed it going away.
Do you still feel pleasure when you engage in those hobbies, or does it feel like you're just going through the motions without really enjoying them?

No, I still enjoy them. I definitely still feel pleasure when I do them. It's not like I'm just going through the motions or anything... I still get into it and have fun. It's just, like I said, that heavy feeling is sort of always there underneath it all. But the actual enjoyment is still there, yeah.
Besides that heavy feeling, do you find yourself feeling down or hopeless at times?

Yeah, hopeless is probably a good word for it. I used to have everything mapped out, like my plans for finishing college and getting an MBA, and exactly how I'd move up in my career. But lately... I don't know, I look at those same plans and I just assume I'm not going to get there. It feels like no matter how much I try or what I do, it won't work out anyway. So yeah, I definitely feel hopeless about the future.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual, or that you're lacking energy, even if you haven't done much physically?

Yeah, definitely. It's like... by the afternoon, I'm just completely wiped out. And it doesn't even have to be a physically demanding day. Just doing basic stuff at work, like fixing a simple spreadsheet error or finishing up expense paperwork, feels exhausting. Even trying to get myself to play soccer later... it just feels like I'm dragging my body and my brain through mud. I just have no energy left.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately, like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?
No, not really. My appetite has been pretty much the same. I haven't noticed any weight loss or eating less than normal. I'm still eating my regular meals.
Have you had any trouble sleeping lately, like difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up earlier than you intended?

No, my sleep has been fine. I fall asleep okay and I usually sleep through the night without any issues. I'm not waking up super early or anything like that. It's just the tiredness during the day that's the problem, but the actual sleeping part hasn't changed.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual or that even small tasks take a lot more effort than before?

Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I know I said things feel exhausting because I'm so tired, but I'm not actually moving slower. My physical pace is pretty much normal. It's not like I'm moving in slow motion or anything like that, it's just the energy part that's drained.
Would you say that your mood has been depressed most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just feeling hopeless or tired?

Yeah, I would say so. That's actually why I decided to come in. For a really long time now, I've just been walking around with this... flat, heavy feeling. It's not just about being tired. Even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me, I still just feel down and kind of empty most days. So yeah, it's definitely there pretty much all day.
Have you ever felt like life isn't worth living, or have you had thoughts about death or not wanting to go on?

No, I haven't really had thoughts like that. I mean, I feel down and empty, like I said, but it's never gotten to the point where I think about death or feel like I don't want to be here anymore. I'm just tired of feeling this way, but I don't want to hurt myself or anything.
